title: Samo's Empire
capsule: Samo's Empire (623–658/661) was the first attested political union of Slavic tribes in Central Europe, founded by Samo, a Frankish merchant who led the Slavs in a successful revolt against Avar overlordship around 623 and was elected king. At its height the realm encompassed Bohemia, Moravia, and parts of modern Austria and Slovenia, and Samo decisively repelled a Frankish invasion at the Battle of Wogastisburg (631/632). The polity dissolved at Samo's death around 658–661, leaving no dynastic successor.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. Territorial extent is poorly attested; the sole primary source is the Chronicle of Fredegar, which gives no systematic geographic description, and modern reconstructions rely heavily on inference from archaeological and linguistic data.
